taxonomy.note: Current Kew treatment accepts Asclepias incarnata and includes Texas in its native range.

target_zone_range.note: USDA PLANTS/BONAP-derived county distribution locks multiple exact project target-zone counties. TPWD independently documents swamp milkweed along perennial streams in the Edwards Plateau and a Llano County occurrence.

morphology_keys.habit: Erect perennial milkweed of wet ground, stream margins, and other moist sites.
morphology_keys.leaf_morphology: Leaves narrow and elongate, giving the plant a noticeably slender-leaved look.
morphology_keys.look_here_first: Start with the wet-site habitat, erect habit, narrow opposite leaves, and rounded pink flower umbels.

field_diagnostics.note: Use habitat plus leaf arrangement and flower color together; flower color alone is not sufficient for identification.

ecological_notes.habitat: Moist ground and perennial-stream settings; TPWD specifically documents the species in Edwards Plateau riparian habitat.
ecological_notes.central_texas_note: The verified project range includes multiple western and northwestern target-zone counties, including Llano, Gillespie, Kerr, Kimble, Mason, Menard, Burnet, and Tom Green.
ecological_notes.host_status: Native milkweed and monarch larval host.
